label: Cron example
info: Nuclio owns the schedule and invokes the function every 30 seconds.

name: example-cron-timestamp
configCode:
apiVersion: "nuclio.io/v1"
kind: NuclioFunction
spec:
  triggers:
    cron:
      kind: cron
      attributes:
        interval: 30s
        body: '{"source":"node-red-cron-example"}'

name: Nuclio-owned schedule
info: The function deploys on Node-RED startup, then Nuclio owns the 30-second schedule. Open the function Status tab and refresh Run logs to observe each tick. This demonstrates a trigger schedule, not durable batch orchestration or backfill support.
